truth_classes.OBSERVED: A value selected from a named public source.
truth_classes.DERIVED: A reproducible transformation or relationship computed from sourced data.
truth_classes.MODELED: A synthetic assumption used only in the bounded replay.
truth_classes.MIXED: A record containing explicitly enumerated observed and modeled fields.

sources.title: On-Time Performance, January 2024
sources.use: Six ORD schedule identities, directions, routes, and scheduled movement times.
sources.decision_boundary: Only schedule fields are projected into the replay. Actual times, cancellations, diversions, and delay outcomes are excluded from agent decisions.

sources.title: Global Hourly KORD observations, 2024
sources.use: KORD observations at 08:00 and 09:04 CST, including visibility, wind, ceiling, and present weather.
sources.decision_boundary: Each observation becomes available only when the replay clock reaches its observation time.

sources.title: NASR airport and runway records
sources.use: ORD identity plus displayed runway designators and published lengths.
sources.decision_boundary: The top-down screen is schematic; it does not claim surveyed taxiway geometry.

sources.title: Bounded replay assumptions
sources.use: Gate occupancy and compatibility, capacity effects, task times, baggage event, runway inspection, recovery actions, projected outcomes, and synthetic organizational policy.

derived_relationships.method: Flights paired using post-event BTS tail continuity for a retrospective replay.
derived_relationships.decision_boundary: Treated as a modeled replay assumption rather than publicly available 09:00 operational evidence.

derived_relationships.method: Declared by the synthetic versioned policy pack.
derived_relationships.decision_boundary: Used only to demonstrate Company Brain freshness and authorization behavior.
